title: Prove intermediate ranges before algebraic reassociation or hoisting

source.title: vLLM PR #55532 AWQ hoist overflow review
source.claim_scope: A legal FP16 counterexample rejected the source transformation; it is a correctness guard, not target performance evidence.

implementation_recipe: Derive bounds for every original and newly materialized intermediate.
Account for rounding, saturation, fused operations and signed infinities in the actual execution dtype.
Reject the rewrite when any legal input leaves the original finite domain but overflows the new intermediate.
validation_recipe: Generate boundary values from dtype maxima and quantizer extrema rather than random inputs alone.
Emulate or execute exact fused-FMA semantics for the target dtype.
Run adversarial held-out values before timing.
expected_bottleneck_shifts: A rejected unsafe candidate should consume only correctness-screen budget, never performance-measurement budget.
failure_modes: Source-level algebraic equivalence is assumed to imply floating-point equivalence.
The hoisted product has a wider dynamic range than the bounded original difference.
Tests cover typical scales but omit legal extrema.
scope_limits: This guard does not prohibit reassociation when the new range is proven safe or a wider accumulator is used.

candidate_archetypes.name: range-gated invariant hoist
candidate_archetypes.template: Hoist only after proving the materialized invariant is representable for the entire public input domain.
